# CustomTitlebar renaming did not rename its persisted preference

Entry 1377 renames the JS object and observed DOM attribute from TabsInTitlebar/tabsintitlebar to CustomTitlebar/customtitlebar across the window, styles and toolbar-state cache. The accepted object still reads mail.tabs.drawInTitlebar. For this UI naming change, keep the persisted preference separate from implementation and selector names; renaming the object is not a preference migration. This is scoped naming guidance, not a project-wide attribute casing rule. No test, build or runtime operation was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending; source landing alone does not establish reviewer approval.

Scope: Custom titlebar naming and persisted setting.
